svg.title: SEALER architecture
svg.desc: Two SEALER apps, Android and iPhone, use the same QT core in Rust through UniFFI bindings. Encryption happens in the core, on each phone. The apps exchange encrypted envelopes through a relay on AWS in Stockholm (HAProxy with TLS, a Rust relay and Redis), using Noise_XX over wss with the relay key pinned in the apps. The relay never sees the content or the sender. The core has four parts: core, transport, storage and ffi. The sealer.pt website is separate, on Cloudflare, and never talks to the relay.
